Hardik Pandya's Bowling Fitness Questioned Ahead of ODIs

Former India cricketer Gautam Gambhir stated that all-rounder Hardik Pandya is not yet fit to bowl 10 overs and will not be rushed back into play. This assessment comes amid discussions about Pandya's and Rishabh Pant's exclusions from the West Indies ODIs, with their fitness and form being key considerations. The coverage focuses on the ongoing evaluation of Pandya's readiness for international cricket.
